title: Department of Expenditure (Finance Ministry) office memorandum dated 10 Nov 2026: EVs 'shall be the default and preferred choice for procurement' when central ministries and departments condemn or replace petrol/diesel staff cars; net dealer price cap ₹20 lakh for electric staff cars, ₹10 lakh unchanged for petrol, diesel and hybrid; non-EV purchase needs a justified proposal approved by the ministry's Secretary with its Financial Adviser's concurrence, decided case by case by the Department of Expenditure; 1 Sep 2022 EV-hiring rule stays; in force immediately
